Home / Commitments

Our commitments

Safety, cleanliness, quality, environmental management and meeting deadlines are our priorities on every site.

Safety

The safety of our workers, road users and residents comes first. Our teams are trained and equipped to work on public roads, near utilities and at height.

  • First-aid at work, refreshed every two years
  • AIPR utility proximity certification
  • Work at height and harness use
  • 60 temporary signage kits, 8 site traffic lights
  • Full PPE, extinguishers and first-aid kits on site

Quality and deadlines

Each project is assigned to a site manager and a foreman who specialise in the trade concerned. Owning our equipment lets us keep to schedule, including for emergency works.

  • Trade-specialised supervision
  • Setting out and control: lasers, optical levels
  • Network testing and commissioning
  • Paperless: invoices via Chorus Pro, electronic tender submissions

Environment

We work on islands where water, soil and landscapes are precious. Our sites include runoff management, stream protection and prevention of damage to existing networks.

  • Stormwater and runoff management
  • Stream clearing and protection
  • Utility detection before works
  • Clean sites and reinstatement

Skills and local roots

Our vision: make TMI a platform that invests in local skills. We train our people throughout their careers and contribute to social inclusion on our islands.

  • Administrative, technical, safety and environmental training plans
  • Qualifying courses, including drinking water networks with Afpa
  • Local hiring in Guadeloupe and Saint-Martin

Public works company founded in 2023: water networks, roads and asphalt, utilities, special works, building and civil engineering.
